svg.title: The way of a file from the inbox to Paperless
svg.desc: In the next run, a file in the folder Eingang is uploaded to Paperless. When Paperless is unreachable or overloaded, the file waits 15 minutes, then twice as long each time, up to a day, and is uploaded again. When Paperless refuses it, such as a file of an unsupported type, it stays in Eingang and is skipped until it is saved anew, renamed or replaced. When Paperless accepts it, the next runs follow its Paperless task while it is running: after success, the file is removed from Eingang or kept, as configured; after a failure, it moves to the folder Fehler, next to a .error.txt with the reason.
